recipe_of: T2 (final-culturax-230m, epoch2 at 1,306,000; experiments/final/protocol.md, start_final.sh at 1c8f2c7)

legs.note: one run; resumed only after a preemption or reboot, or by the float32 rule

schedule.note: warmup as optax.warmup_cosine_decay_schedule, then 4.8e-4 to step 1,040,000, then 4.8e-4 - (4.8e-4 - 1e-6) * sqrt(f) over the last 266,000 steps; per step the schedule of T2

precision.rule: after a self-stop (50 non-finite steps in a row): resume from the last checkpoint in float32 to the next multiple of 10,000 after the stop, then bf16; at most 5 times (protocol.md)

data.shares: stage_optout.py plan from manifest.json: the kept/train files in name order, every file split over the 4 hosts in segments of 1,000 rows taken in rounds (scripts/stage_share.py); the plan, with the sha256 of the manifest, to gs://t5-dutch-english-usc2/mbert/final-v2/plan/
data.files_list: ~/fw2optout_files.txt (the plan's order, files without rows for the host left out)
data.dataset_num_rows: kept/train documents less those of hebban.nl (blocklist_scan.py), in ~/fw2optout_files.rows
data.heldout: kept/test less every document also in kept/train (same id or same sha256 of the text): ~/fw2optout_heldout.parquet, its md5 in ~/fw2optout_heldout.parquet.md5
